accountDeletion.title: Delete account
accountDeletion.description: Permanently delete your Studafy account and your personal data.
accountDeletion.heading: Delete your account
accountDeletion.pending: A deletion request is already in progress (filed {{date}}). We'll process it within 30 days.
accountDeletion.consequenceSignOut: Sign you out on every device straight away and remove your access to your school.
accountDeletion.consequenceProfile: Erase your name, contact details and profile from Studafy within 30 days.
accountDeletion.consequenceBilling: Stop any AI subscription paid for on Studafy's website from renewing. A subscription bought in the App Store or Google Play is billed by Apple or Google: cancel it in the store.
accountDeletion.consequenceRetained: Keep only what your school must legally retain: your grades and attendance (without your name or contact details), plus financial and audit records.
accountDeletion.previousFailed: Your last deletion request couldn't be completed. Please try again or contact your school.
accountDeletion.confirmBody: You'll be signed out everywhere right away, and your account will be deleted in 14 days unless you sign in and cancel.
accountDeletion.completedBody: You've been signed out on every device. Your account will be deleted on {{scheduledDate}}; sign in before then to cancel. Your personal data will be erased by {{date}}.
accountDeletion.completedRetainedIntro: Your school keeps only these records, as the law requires:
accountDeletion.pendingGateTitle: Your account is scheduled for deletion
accountDeletion.pendingGateBody: Your account will be deleted on {{date}}. Cancel the deletion to keep using Studafy.
accountDeletion.pendingGateFailed: The deletion couldn't be cancelled. Try again.

storeWarning.title: Cancel your App Store or Google Play subscription
storeWarning.ownBody: You have an AI Study Assistant subscription billed by Apple (App Store) or Google (Google Play), not by Studafy. Deleting your account doesn't cancel it, so you may keep being charged until you cancel it in the store.
storeWarning.googlePlayNote: For Google Play, we also try to stop the renewal when your account is finally deleted, but cancel it yourself to be sure.
storeWarning.childBody: A child linked to your account has an AI Study Assistant subscription billed by Apple or Google. Deleting your account doesn't cancel it or delete your child's account. If it's billed to your store account and you want it to stop, cancel it in the store.
storeWarning.appStoreSteps: App Store: on the iPhone or iPad that bought it, open Settings, tap your name, then Subscriptions, choose Studafy and tap Cancel Subscription.
storeWarning.googlePlaySteps: Google Play: open the Google Play app, tap your profile picture, then Payments & subscriptions, then Subscriptions, choose Studafy and tap Cancel subscription.

retained.academic_grades: Grades, without your name or contact details

legalAcceptance.title: Before you continue
legalAcceptance.body: To use Studafy, please read and accept our Terms of Service and read our Privacy Policy. They explain how Studafy works, what you may use it for, and how your school and Studafy look after your personal data.
legalAcceptance.updatedBody: Our Terms of Service or Privacy Policy have changed since you last accepted them. Please read the current versions and accept them to continue using Studafy.
legalAcceptance.termsLink: Terms of Service (opens in a new tab)
legalAcceptance.privacyLink: Privacy Policy (opens in a new tab)
legalAcceptance.checkbox: I accept the Terms of Service and I have read the Privacy Policy.
legalAcceptance.required: Tick the box to accept the Terms of Service and confirm you have read the Privacy Policy.
legalAcceptance.decline: If you do not accept, you can sign out or <deleteLink>delete your account</deleteLink>.
legalAcceptance.outdated: The terms changed while this page was open. Reload the page to see the current versions.
legalAcceptance.failed: Your acceptance could not be saved. Please try again.
